intro: Your assigned visits. Times are recorded by the server when you start and complete a visit.
empty: No assigned visits on this date.
error: This action could not be completed. No success has been assumed.
denied: You cannot access this visit in the current agency workspace.
stale: This visit changed. Refresh before retrying.
validation: Review the required fields and task outcomes.
savedRefreshFailed: The server confirmed the change, but the latest view could not be loaded. Refresh before making another change.
noteHelp: Your draft is saved on the server and finalized when you complete the visit. After completion it cannot be edited.
startHelp: The server records the actual start time.
completeHelp: Every required task needs an outcome. The server records the actual end time and finalizes your note.
